calls.title: Approvals on Experiments
calls.summary: The team discussed improving the linkage between experiments and feature flags to reduce friction in approval processes. Bryce Fitzsimons proposed a model where each new experiment automatically generates a feature flag, allowing for a one-to-one mapping. Luke Sonnet and Guy Langford-lee highlighted the need for UI and API controls for managing approvals directly from the experiment interface, while addressing the complexities of governance in large organizations. A revisions system for experiments was deemed crucial to manage changes and approvals effectively. Customer needs varied; some demanded simpler integrations, while others required multiple flags per experiment. The team also identified UI improvements to streamline workflows, alongside strategic discussions on balancing governance and usability.
calls.keywords: approval flows, feature flags, experiments, revision system, managed-by linkage, experiment governance
